name: inspira-flickering-grid
title: Flickering Grid
blurb: Canvas grid of squares that flicker independently at random intervals.
description: Canvas-based flickering grid background where each square randomly toggles between transparent and opaque. Fully responsive with configurable square size, spacing, and flicker speed.
use_when: A performance-conscious animated grid background for subtle visual interest.
avoid_when: Very small grid gaps may impact rendering performance on low-end devices.
a11y: Decorative canvas overlay; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. Flickering has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
